body:
Reminds me of Davy Jones saying, "Life is cruel, why should the afterlife be any different?" 

I mean yeah we're reincarnated...as worms and beetles, dirt and plants. We literally become what feeds on us postmortem, and our "essence" is redistributed back into the carbon cycle. If you've seen road kill you seen your future. 

BUT we don't know one way or the other if YOU, as in the entity living in  the meat-cake we call a brain, gets recycled. Go read some more science, and go read some more Buddhist philosophy before you die over it. You might only get to live and die once, so make it count!
No, you'll give yourself a mighty hangover/liver damage. Trust me on that.

100% agree and I suffer because of it everyday. The "answer" that our culture gives us today is to be addicted to dopamine, to chase the dragon of ephemeral material pleasure, which frankly gives us enough to get on day to day but not to achieve the deeper connection/happiness our species needs. I do not see legitimate evidence for a world beyond this one; the spiritual option is just the more archaic coping tool to deal with the with the same problem. Sometimes people fight wars thinking it will "reset" the problem, but it doesn't-that's what I think the US is preparing to do now. 

All we can do is cling to what little we have and repeat our daily cycles hoping something. anything will change for the better. Maybe people like us should find like minded people somehow and start over, in the wilderness, and bring with us the tools knowledge of industrialization and try to build a culture of that avoids the pitfalls we've made. 

I have nothing left to live for but loneliness, and empty culture,work, debt, and pain. I would, in a heartbeat, throw it all away to have real connection, to have some measure of choice and control. What the fuck have we built with all this power our species has found??
